headline: Meta strikes deal to help Zuckerberg pay California's proposed billionaire tax
summary: Meta arranged a stock deal to help CEO Mark Zuckerberg cover a possible California wealth tax on billionaires, in exchange for his commitment to stay in the state for eight years. Outlets say the board feared his departure could disrupt Meta's AI ambitions, and that Zuckerberg had earlier threatened to leave over the not-yet-enacted tax.
